segments.text: Global news in eighty seconds. Three verified updates, checked October third.
First, Eritrea has severed diplomatic ties with Ethiopia after Ethiopia ordered its embassy in Asmara closed.
Reuters reports that Ethiopia also told ten Eritrean diplomats to leave within forty eight hours.
The moves come amid renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia.
Second, western Europe recorded its hottest summer, according to a new Copernicus review released October second.
Europe as a whole had its third warmest summer.
Reuters reports that fifty two percent of the continent had faced very strong heat stress by the end of summer.
That figure describes affected land, rather than a count of people harmed.
Third, four astronauts have reached the International Space Station aboard SpaceX's Crew Thirteen mission.
NASA confirms Dragon docked on October first, Eastern time, after a flight lasting seven hours and fifty five minutes.
The agency calls it the fastest launch to docking by a United States spacecraft in the station's history.
The crew includes astronauts from NASA, Canada, and Russia.
Read the original source links in the description for more details.
